يتبحبحون (form IIq)
# يَتَبَحْبَحُونَ (yatabaḥbaḥūna) /ja.ta.baħ.ba.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# يُتَبَحْبَحُونَ (yutabaḥbaḥūna) /ju.ta.baħ.ba.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
